messages:
elaine (Partnerships): Heads-up — we need a compact oncall liaison runbook for partner SEV handoffs (cloud marketplace + HW partners + SI). Ops asked for a 1-page checklist we can drop into partner channels.

sam (SE): +1. Can we make it strict about channel setup + who creates the war room? Too many last-minute conf calls.

mike (Support): From support side: we need clear routing: who owns initial triage, who owns partner comms, and when to escalate to eng.

julia (Solutions): Also include the preferred bridge template and the sponsor contact (partner PM / account lead). Partners expect a single point of contact on our side.

elaine (Partnerships): Draft proposal below — please reply with edits. Goal: one message to paste into a shared channel to kick off.

=== PROPOSED ONCALL LIAISON RUNBOOK ===
1) Channel & initial msg
- Create or pin a shared channel: #partner-<partner>-sev (partners + our SE + oncall).
- Post root message: short summary, SEV level, impact, starting timestamp, contact info.
- Tag: @oncall and partner account lead.

2) Triage ownership (first 10m)
- Support: acknowledge, collect logs, reproduce steps.
- SE (partner specialist): validate whether partner-provided artifact is culprit.
- If not reproducible within 10m, escalate to Eng (eng-runtime).

3) War room & bridge
- If SEV >= 2 or cross-org impact: create war room via our incident bot: `/warroom create --summary "Partner <partner> SEV<level>" --channel #partner-<partner>-sev`
- Bridge: prefer Zoom + Slack pinned link. Use the standard bridge template: Zoom ID + readout doc link.
- oncall-bot will auto-post runbook steps when war room is created.

4) Communication cadence
- Every 15m status update in channel for first hour, then every 30m until recovery.
- Use simple headings: Root cause hypothesis / Next action / Owner / ETA.

5) Handoff to partner (closing)
- Before closing: confirm partner can reproduce fix in their environment.
- Share postmortem timeline draft w/in 24h. Assign a postmortem owner (usually SE).

6) Escalation matrix (quick)
- SEV 1: Eng on-call + partner exec brief (if >1 region affected).
- SEV 2: Eng on-call + partner solutions + weekly exec sync if unresolved >4h.
- SEV 3: Support + SE, channel-only updates, document workaround.

7) Quick templates (paste into channel)
- Initial msg: `@oncall We have SEV<level> affecting <partner> — short summary. Attach logs + repro. Contact: <partner PM> / <our SE>. Requested action: triage.`
- Escalate to eng: `@eng-runtime escalating SEV<level> — need kernel team for model memory leak. See logs: <link>.`

8) Follow-ups
- Assign owner for billing impact and marketplace listing notes (if applicable).
- If partner public announcement needed, loop in comms and partnerships before any external message.

=== END RUNBOOK ===

sam (SE): This looks good. A couple small nitpicks: reduce the 15m cadence to 10m for first 30m for SEV1s. Also add a line about tagging security for data-exfil suspicion.

mike (Support): +1 to security tag. Also request we standardize the `/warroom create` CLI permission set — some partners can't create channels.

julia (Solutions): For marketplace partners we should add a checkbox: "pause listing updates" if incident impacts model outputs.

elaine (Partnerships): Updated: shortened cadence for SEV1 and added security + marketplace check. I'll paste final into the partner playbook doc and make a tiny Slack snippet for channels.

oncall-bot: War room template link: <https://internal.redwood/warroom-templates/partner-sev> (auto-posted when `/warroom create` is used) :white_check_mark:

sam (SE): Thanks — lets run this by legal for the marketplace pause language.

mike (Support): I'll add the support triage checklist to the shared doc (logs, repro steps, obfuscation guidelines).

elaine (Partnerships): Great. If no objections by EOD I'll ship this to the partner playbook and create a short pinned snippet for #partner-onboarding channel. :rocket:
